messages.text: What would a desktop Goblin feel like?

A quiet place for the things you are working on. Your conversations, tools and personal agent, always close by.

This experiment uses the same content in **three desktop toolkits**. Try sending a message, stopping a reply and scrolling a longer conversation.

Research complete · 3 desktop toolkits
GPUI Kit, Tauri and Electrobun.

conversations.title: From your desk to your phone

messages.text: Does a desktop toolkit replace the mobile spike?
These are separate experiments. One targets React Native and web. GPUI Kit is a Rust UI toolkit; Tauri and Electrobun host browser interfaces on desktop. Shared API contracts can serve all of them.
Can native Markdown display an interactive MCP App?
Interactive MCP Apps need a browser surface with the existing authorization and opaque-frame boundaries. This spike displays text tool results only; it does not execute MCP Apps.
